audit_metadata.task: Phase 9 Task 5 Operational Readiness & Deployment Feasibility Audit

calibrated_classifier_cv_mechanism.subsample_training_size: Trained on (K-1)/K of data per fold, not full training set
calibrated_classifier_cv_mechanism.prediction_ensembling: Averages predicted probabilities across K refitted estimators
calibrated_classifier_cv_mechanism.explanation_of_phase6_ap_drop: Phase 6 reported a drop in PR-AUC under CalibratedClassifierCV(method='sigmoid') not because a monotonic sigmoid alters ranking, but because CalibratedClassifierCV refits K separate clone estimators on subsampled partitions of training data and averages their predictions, producing a different ensemble ranking. Furthermore, isotonic calibration maps continuous scores into flat step plateaus, creating extensive ties and degrading fine-grained ranking resolution.

tier_2_counseling.scope: Persistent alert students with >= 2 alerts (N = 1,869 unique students)

institutional_input_required: Counseling appointment duration allocation (15-min call vs 30-min coaching).
Course-level decentralized tutoring vs centralized student support responsibilities.

integration_gap_analysis.gap_description: ModuleGGGGovernanceRouter currently suppresses CMAs exclusively for Module GGG. For modules AAA through FFF, CMAs currently default to suppress_automated_outreach=False. In production, institutional router must explicitly suppress automated advisor outreach for CMAs across ALL modules to enforce the 'Research-Only' governance mandate.
integration_gap_analysis.metadata_audit_trail_gap: The router records module, assessment type, probability, threshold, and recommendation, but does not currently log the model_name, model_version, or input_feature_hash.

static_registration_features.real_world_feasibility: VERIFIED (Available in Student Information System prior to prediction cutoff)

vle_engagement_telemetry.timing: Filtered strictly to events with date <= cutoff_date
vle_engagement_telemetry.telemetry_latency_constraint: In real-world learning management systems, clickstream events require an ETL pipeline (event stream or nightly batch). A 7-day pre-deadline prediction horizon provides sufficient operational buffer for a 24-48h ingestion lag. However, a 1-day horizon is operationally brittle and would fail under clickstream ingestion delays.

historical_assessment_grades_and_publica.grading_delay_critical_caveat: OULAD records only date_submitted and final score; it DOES NOT record the actual date when tutors finished grading or when grades were released to students. The 14-day delay is a simulated policy benchmark. Real-world deployment requires linking to actual gradebook release events in the LMS/SIS. Tutors who take >14 days would leave scores unobserved, reverting the student to cold-start feature routing.

section_5_shadow_mode_design.deployment_mode: Silent / Passive Shadow Mode (Zero Student Outreach)

advisor_review_protocol.access_channel: Internal, read-only academic advisor risk portal
advisor_review_protocol.student_contact_rule: NO direct student messaging triggered automatically by model
advisor_review_protocol.weekly_review_cadence: Advisors review flagged rosters at weekly mentoring huddles
advisor_review_protocol.qualitative_feedback_logging: Advisors log whether flagged students sought help or showed early difficulty

shadow_telemetry_monitoring_gates.missing_data_monitoring: Track cold-start rate; trigger alert if missing prior scores exceed 25%
shadow_telemetry_monitoring_gates.feature_drift_monitoring: Weekly continuous PSI calculation on clicks_last_7d and days_since_last_click (alert if PSI > 0.20)
shadow_telemetry_monitoring_gates.ingestion_latency_tracking: Log delta between LMS event timestamps and model scoring run (alert if lag > 24h)
shadow_telemetry_monitoring_gates.alert_volume_volatility: Flag if weekly alert proportion deviates > 25% from expected 15-20% benchmark
shadow_telemetry_monitoring_gates.calibration_drift_audit: Compute rolling Brier score and ECE against published retrospective grades

incident_investigation_procedure.false_positive_audit: Review students with P >= 0.20 who scored >= 75; investigate whether informal tutor support or late cramming occurred
incident_investigation_procedure.false_negative_audit: Review students with P < 0.20 who scored < 50; inspect sudden drop-off, illness flags, or cold-start feature sparsity
